labeling: gold_kb_ids = KB entries whose TITLE has trigram-Jaccard >= 0.30 with the FAQ question, minus 7 manually rejected pairs (same words, different topic) and 2 manual additions, plus a second manual pass after reading the system's answers (FAQ 14, 16, 18, 33, 34, 61, 84, 111 had a clearly relevant KB entry that the title similarity missed). Labeled by the assistant; the KB owner should confirm. Answers are not stored here.
